Q5460.reason: A statement by an employee about a matter within the scope of their employment, made during that employment, is a non-hearsay party-opponent admission under FRE 801(d)(2)(D). The employee doesn't have to have taken part in the negligent act.

Q8222.reason: Fever, fatigue and cold symptoms in a heavily immunosuppressed transplant recipient after anti-CD3 therapy best fit EBV. BK virus usually causes graft dysfunction without fever or cold symptoms.

Q5849.reason: The defendant only said the records were kept regularly. That isn't enough foundation for the business-records exception or for authentication, and being available to testify doesn't take the records outside the hearsay rule.
